description: Nemo escapes the Kalpani penal colony aboard the submarine he was forced to build, gathering an improvised crew while the East India Company hunts them across the ocean. Survival, revenge and the discovery of what the Nautilus can do gradually turn an escape into a campaign against the institution that destroyed Nemo's old life.

s01e01.description: Nemo and the prisoners of Kalpani are forced to build the Nautilus for the East India Company. When Director Crawley orders the completed submarine moved immediately, Nemo has to launch his escape before his carefully prepared crew is ready.

s01e02.description: Attempts to abandon the Nautilus expose the fugitives to Company forces, forcing everyone back aboard. A whaling encounter delays their escape and turns the submarine's first voyage into a tense underwater pursuit.

s01e03.description: The Nautilus stops at Karajan for water and supplies, where Nemo discovers a truth he did not expect and the crew learns more about the identity and history of the man now commanding them.

s01e04.description: Hunger drives the crew onto an apparently deserted island. When Blaster disappears, Nemo and Humility search for him and discover that the island's most immediate problem is a gigantic electric eel.

s01e05.description: An underwater volcanic chain frees the Nautilus from the giant eel but leaves the damaged submarine sinking toward lava. As a fast-spreading infection causes hallucinations across the crew, Humility must overcome her own panic and repair the rudder outside the vessel.

s01e06.description: Clues hidden around the underwater volcanoes point toward Atlantis. Nemo leads a small group into what appears to be an ancient outpost, only to find that its beautiful surroundings conceal lethal sea life.

s01e07.description: A battle with the Company's Dreadnought strands both ships in Arctic ice and produces an uneasy truce. Nemo is reunited with someone from his past and receives new information about his father that unsettles his sense of purpose.

s01e08.description: The crew finally turns on Nemo's increasingly reckless command and confines him while Boniface takes over. Near the magnetic north pole, mounting danger forces Nemo to confront the mistrust he created and reveal more of who he really is.

s01e09.description: Reaching the long-sought treasure does not bring the victory Nemo expected: the site is guarded, the crew is exhausted, and the journey appears to have carried them to the edge of the world for nothing.

s01e10.description: Nemo turns from escape to open war against the East India Company. The crew attacks its credibility and share price, then races to reach an owners' meeting where they hope to dismantle the institution that ruined so many of their lives.
